scope: Historical rates used for the frozen September 2026 evaluation; not a current price quotation.
unit: USD per million tokens unless otherwise indicated
notes: Gemini completion tokens include reported thinking tokens.
Anthropic input tokens exclude cache reads and writes; those are added separately.
For Gemini and OpenAI-compatible token accounting, cached inputs are a subset of input tokens.
Missing usage or reported cost remains unknown, not zero.
GPU cost is an active-request rental equivalent including failed attempts; model loading, idle allocation and other hosting costs are excluded.
API token-rate costs and GPU rental equivalents are not provider billing statements.
